sources.title: Kazmania/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SmolLM2 demonstrates significant advances over its predecessor SmolLM1, particularly in instruction following, knowledge, reasoning. The 135M model was trained on 2 trillion tokens using a diverse dataset combination: FineWeb-Edu, DCLM, The Stack, along with new filtered datasets we curated and will release soon.

sources.title: Run SmolLM2-135M Local AI Model Tutorial — AI Tutorial
sources.snippet: SmolLM2-135M-Instruct is an instruction-tuned model, meaning it expects a specific format for prompts to generate coherent and safe responses. Unlike base models, you cannot just pass raw text; you must structure the input as a conversation or a specific instruction.

sources.title: SmolLM2-135M Private LLM for Ops AI | Self-Hosted
sources.snippet: Open-Weight LLM · Private & Custom AI SmolLM2-135M-Instruct Ultra-lightweight instruction-tuned LLM for on-device ops automation, custom workflows, and private deployment on standard edge hardware. SmolLM2-135M-Instruct is a 135M-parameter transformer trained on 2T tokens, instruction-tuned via SFT and DPO. It's designed to run locally without GPU or on minimal compute—ideal for ops teams ...
